comment: Recognition layer 2: community/district entry signs. Lat/lon places the trigger in world space via road.project(). trigger_radius is in compressed-world metres. needs_owner_review: true means the coordinate or note is uncertain — the owner's lived knowledge is authoritative over map data.

communities.name: Palisadoes
communities.note: The tombolo strip; sea on both sides — Gun Boat Beach / harbour on the left, open sea on the right

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: Eastern Kingston suburb at the foot of the Palisadoes; gateway roundabout into the city

communities.name: Rockfort
communities.note: Industrial and residential strip along Windward Road

communities.name: Wareika Hill
communities.note: East Kingston Rastafari community; exact road placement uncertain

communities.name: Cross Roads
communities.note: Major Kingston junction where Half Way Tree Road meets South Camp Road

communities.name: New Kingston
communities.note: Modern business and hotel district of Kingston

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: Main commercial hub of Kingston / St. Andrew; the Half Way Tree clock tower is an unmissable landmark

communities.name: Washington Gardens
communities.note: Kingston residential suburb along Spanish Town Road

communities.name: Riverton
communities.note: Community in western Kingston along Spanish Town Road; Riverton City area

communities.name: Spanish Town
communities.note: Former capital of Jamaica (St. Catherine); route uses the bypass; great square and cathedral are nearby

communities.name: Sligoville
communities.note: First free village in Jamaica (1838); on the Sligoville Road heading north to Bog Walk

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Rio Cobre gorge community; Flat Bridge is the centrepiece of this dramatic stretch

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: St. Catherine market town; immortalised in the folk song Linstead Market (Carry mi ackee go a Linstead Market…)

communities.name: Mount Rosser
communities.note: Hill community between Linstead and Moneague; potential off-road moment territory

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: St. Ann hill town; gateway to the north coast

communities.name: Faith's Pen
communities.note: Famous roadside cookshop village on the A1; jerk chicken, roast yam, festival, cold drinks

communities.name: Claremont
communities.note: St. Ann community on the descent toward Fern Gully

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: Canopy of tree ferns arching over the road — one of Jamaica's most iconic drives

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: North coast resort town; end of the Airport Run — Dunn's River Falls awaits
